opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioners are challenging the order dated 31.01.2019 passed by the Adjudicating Authority/Additional District Magistrate (Admn.), Gautam Buddh Nagar in exercise of powers under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the consequential recovery dated 25.07.2019.
The aforesaid order is appellable under Section 70 of the Act before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal and the order of the Tribunal thereof is further appellable to the High Court under Section 71(6)/76 of the Act.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The petitioners cannot succeed in challenging the aforesaid recovery as it is consequential to the order dated 31.01.2019 until and unless the petitioners succeed in getting the said order set aside or quashed.
In view of the above alternative remedies so available to the petitioners to assail the order dated 31.01.2019 passed by the Adjudicating Authority, we do not deem it necessary to exercise our discretionary jurisdiction in the matter.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed on the ground of alternate remedy with liberty to file appeal.
